name: Symbiont Resilience
body:
Your symbiont can afford you additional protection.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 4 ranks

Benefit(s): You may gain the damage reduction from a symbiont you are currently bonded with for a number of rounds per day equal to twice the plant symbiont’s Hit Dice. Activating this feat is a swift action and the effect can be ended with a free action. The rounds do not have to be used consecutively but are used in 1-round increments.

If you are bonded with more than one plant symbiont, you must choose which plant symbiont you gain damage reduction from. You must remain bonded with the plant symbiont while benefiting from its damage reduction.
